options.label: G10 clause narrowed to planOf; the definition sentence restated to say buildDefinition() is planOf(this).definition here, throwing whatever planOf throws and UnimplementedError otherwise; one sentence saying neither G9 nor G10 is in the restriction, why, where they first replay, and that package tests check both for planOf

decisions.chosen: G10 clause narrowed to planOf; the definition sentence restated to say buildDefinition() is planOf(this).definition here, throwing whatever planOf throws and UnimplementedError otherwise; one sentence saying neither G9 nor G10 is in the restriction, why, where they first replay, and that package tests check both for planOf

It adds no work: topology-dsl@v2 Refinement 2 defines buildDefinition() as planOf(this).definition, and S127's plan (Interface constraints, Task 1) already lands exactly that. Treating G9 and G10 in one sentence states the rule the plan already applies to topology-ir@v1 at .10 (G3, G7 and G23 join later restrictions). A reviewer who wanted the plan text to say nothing about buildDefinition()'s body at .9 would have changed this.
